theme_and_archetype.mood: Cinematic, exclusive, immersive, and magical. The app is a private screening room where the Master projects images to the Players.
theme_and_archetype.rationale: For a real-time image sharing platform, a deep dark theme ensures the shared images (the primary content) stand out brilliantly against the background, akin to a movie theater or a high-end digital art gallery.

typography.strategy: The 'Editorial Future' pairing: Wide Display Sans for impactful headers + Crisp Geometric Sans for UI data.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-zinc-50 leading-none
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-50
hierarchy.caption: text-sm text-zinc-500

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8, p-12) for the Landing and Player views to feel like a gallery. Tight, functional 'Control Room' grid (gap-4) for the Master dashboard.

grids.player_view: h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative

surfaces.master_cards: bg-zinc-900/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]
surfaces.player_glass_overlay: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-white/10 p-6 absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full

landing.description: Split intent gateway. Massive centered hero typography over a dark cinematic background.
landing.layout: Use a full-screen background image with a heavy bg-black/70 overlay. Two dominant call-to-actions in the center.
components: Hero Title: 'Proietta il tuo mondo.' (Project your world)
Subtitle: 'Condividi immagini in tempo reale con i tuoi amici.'
Left Card/Button (Master): Rich Amber accent, 'Crea stanza (Master)'
Right Card/Button (Player): Deep Blue accent or Ghost with border, 'Entra come giocatore'

join_room.layout: Centered floating glass card (Crystal Glassmorphism) on a dark textured background.

master_dashboard.description: The Control Room. Technical, dense, and organized.
master_dashboard.layout_grid: lg:grid-cols-12. Left column (col-span-8) for image staging. Right column (col-span-4) for room stats.

sections.header: Sticky nav, Room Code prominent badge (Amber), 'Chiudi stanza' (Close room) button.

stage_area_left.content: Large 'Upload Image or Paste URL' dropzone (dashed border-white/20, hover:border-amber-500/50). Input for 'Caption/Message'. Massive 'INVIA' (Send) button.

stats_area_right.content: List of connected players (using Shadcn Avatar + Name, green dot for online). ScrollArea for live feed.

history_strip_bottom.content: Horizontal ScrollArea (Shadcn) showing thumbnails of previously sent images in this session.

player_view.description: The Art Gallery. Passive, immersive, 100% focused on the received image.
player_view.layout: Full viewport. The received image is max-h-[85vh] max-w-[90vw] object-contain, centered.

elements.main_image: Animated in using Framer Motion (opacity 0 to 1, scale 0.95 to 1, duration 0.8s ease-out).
elements.caption_overlay: Glassmorphism panel (bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl) anchored at the bottom of the screen or bottom of the image, containing the Master's text in big, legible typography (text-2xl md:text-3xl font-heading text-zinc-50).
elements.waiting_state: If no image sent yet: subtle pulsating logo or 'In attesa del master...' (Waiting for master...) in text-zinc-500.
elements.history_trigger: Floating circular button (lucide-react History icon) top-right or bottom-right.
elements.history_sheet: Shadcn Sheet component (Side right). Dark glass background. Shows a vertical list of all past images received with timestamps.

icons.rationale: Clean, scalable, matches the geometric UI.

usage: New player join (Master View): list slide-in
Hover states on Master cards (y-translate -2px, shadow glow)

overrides.inputs: bg-black/50 border-white/10 text-zinc-50 focus:border-amber-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500/50
overrides.buttons: rounded-full or rounded-lg with rigorous transition-all duration-300

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons must explicitly shift bg and text colors. Example: hover:bg-amber-600 hover:text-white.
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: Inputs and buttons must have focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500/50.
motion_and_interactions.image_transition: When Master sends a new image, Player view crossfades smoothly. Do not snap instantly.

accessibility.contrast: Text over the cinematic background or shared images MUST have sufficient text-shadow (e.g., drop-shadow-md) or sit on a glassmorphic background to maintain APCA readability.

hero_background.description: Empty cinematic theater. Use as the full-screen background on the Landing page with a heavy bg-black/60 to bg-black/80 overlay.

sample_image_1.description: Friends around campfire. Use as a placeholder or demo image in the Master's staging area.

sample_image_2.description: Epic glowing landscape. Use as an example of a previously sent image in the history strip.
